title_zh: 改用站立轻步的舞台入场方式

scenario.label_zh: 改用站立轻步的舞台入场方式
scenario.goal_zh: 澄清角色偷偷入场的表演目的，并因服装活动限制决定不采用爬行

context_zh: 虚构剧场排练：演员与导演讨论一位躲避舞台守卫的角色如何进场。
author: author-phase10-b

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: Do you want me to crawl under the bench when the guard turns away?

sentences.speaker: Director
sentences.text: No, just creep across the stage behind him. The audience should see you trying not to make a sound.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: This long coat catches when I kneel. Staying on my feet would be much easier.

sentences.speaker: Director
sentences.text: Then keep upright and take small, quiet steps. We are showing caution, not an escape through a tunnel.

sentences.speaker: Milo
sentences.text: All right. I'll enter after the guard faces the window and stay behind him.

sentences.speaker: Director
sentences.text: Yes. Let's rehearse that standing entrance from his turn toward the window.
